lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white spots are organized into three primary horizontal rows along the mid-flank, with a dense, non-ordered cluster of spots located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical pale bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal carinae to form a rectangular grid; high-luminance circular spots are positioned within the centers of these grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges traverse the flank, showing a sharp vertical intensity gradient characterized by a high-luminance dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density constellation of small-diameter, high-luminance spots distinct from the primary flank patterning.
